info.title: TOGIVA Core API
info.description: Multi-tenant customer engagement platform API. Routes marked x-togiva-status: planned have fixed contracts but are not served yet.

get.summary: Current identity, staff roles, effective permissions and customer memberships
get.description: Creates the user_profiles row on first call from verified token claims. Client apps use this to build role-based navigation; the server still authorizes every call.

post.description: Creates the global customer profile if needed and an organization-specific membership. Idempotent: calling again returns the existing membership.

get.summary: Resolve a client application's configured organization slug to its public summary (active organizations only)

get.description: Staff see locations where they hold location.read. Customers and members see active, loyalty-participating locations.

post.summary: Generate a four-digit connection code for a location
post.description: Revokes the customer's previous active code (a code already reserved by a cashier is left to finish). The raw code is returned only in this response.

get.summary: State of the customer's most recent code (for countdown and pending purchase display)

post.summary: Identify a customer by code and reserve the code for this checkout
post.description: Atomic: of concurrent lookups for the same code exactly one succeeds. Returns minimal identification only. Failed attempts count toward per-employee and per-location lockouts.

post.summary: Cancel a reservation (wrong customer, abandoned checkout); the code becomes usable again until it expires
Attach the identified customer to a POS order and consume the code
post.description: Creates an association in pending_pos_confirmation. No points are awarded here: the loyalty engine awards points only after the POS confirms the sale.

get.summary: Points, tier progress and next reward
Purchases, points and redemptions, newest first

post.summary: Reserve points for a reward and get a redemption token
